domain: In-vehicle safety system with intrusion detection and door state monitoring.

glossary.definition: Sensor subsystem for intrusion detection inside the vehicle.
Sequence of outbound notifications dispatched when the safety system raises an alarm, including vehicle horn activation and a GSM signal to the security monitoring centre.

business_rules.rule: When the safety system raises an alarm, the vehicle horn must sound at minimum 110 dB for at least 30 seconds, and a GSM notification must be dispatched to the security monitoring centre within 5 seconds of alarm activation.
